versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 – Maintenance update

- ACCEPTANCE.md added.
- No changes to skill logic, workflow, or user-facing functionality.
- Documentation and metadata consistency improved.

Initial release of Physical Therapy Homework Tracker.

- Organizes clinician-prescribed physical therapy homework into a structured home-exercise tracker.
- Tracks adherence, symptom observations, blockers, appointment notes, and clinician questions.
- Provides checklists, adherence logs, and appointment briefs to support following an existing PT plan.
- Includes clear safety boundaries and reminders to consult a clinician for unclear or concerning situations.
- Designed for organizing and communicating about prescribed programs, not for diagnosis or new exercise recommendations.
